prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you want specific shop names and addresses in Pleasanton now, or general recommendations on where to buy and what to look for?

Quick high-level guidance while you decide:
- Best-value places most people use in the Bay Area: Costco Tire Center (if you have a membership), Discount Tire (America’s Tire), and Firestone Complete Auto Care. Those three routinely get good marks for consistent installation quality, warranty handling, and nationwide parts availability.
- Independent local shops can also be excellent (often more personal, quicker appointments) — but quality varies, so check recent Yelp/Google reviews and ask about tech experience.

What makes an installer “best” (questions to ask any shop):
- Do they do a full mounting/balancing and road force/tire balancer check? (road-force is great for reducing vibration)
- Do they check/replace TPMS sensors and reprogram if needed?
- Do they include valve stems, balancing weights, and disposal fees in the quote?
- Do they inspect and recommend wheel alignment, and can they perform alignment in-house?
- What are the warranties (manufacturer + shop workmanship) and road hazard options?
- Can they show post-install tire pressure and a test drive verification?

If you want, I can:
- Look up the top-rated tire shops and chains in Pleasanton with addresses, hours, phone numbers and recent review snippets, or
- Narrow recommendations by vehicle (car, truck, SUV), tire type (all-season, performance, off-road), and whether you want same-day installation.

Which would you prefer?
